name: rtdb-modular-admin-query-index
description: The Admin SDK, which bypasses rules, against an orderByChild query at a location with no `.indexOn`: get() limited and unlimited, and once('value') limited, recording rejections, delivered keys and client log warnings.

getLimited.message: Index not defined, add ".indexOn": "pos", for path "/<base>", to the rules

getUnlimited.message: Index not defined, add ".indexOn": "pos", for path "/<base>", to the rules

logs: warn: @firebase/database: FIREBASE WARNING: Using an unspecified index. Your data will be downloaded and filtered on the client. Consider adding ".indexOn": "pos" at /<base> to your security rules for better performance.
